changelog.text: Introduced NetraMusic Desktop release for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Introduced a completely redesigned UI/UX across Mobile, Desktop, and TV with modern layouts, animations, and a unified visual experience.
Introduced multi-provider synced lyrics with broader song coverage and live sync.
Introduced Radio section for discovering and streaming music stations.
Introduced Party Sync live synced lyrics with role-based playback controls.
Resolved multiple playback, library, UI, sync, and stability issues.
Improved playback session persistence across Mobile, TV, and Desktop.
Enhanced playlist loading with pagination and smooth infinite scrolling.
